decisions.reason: Actually inspected original-source alpha comparisons and complete latest returned raw PNG. Required source-specific correction: The complete latest raw still retains a distinct long yellow throat below the chin above the first pearl strand, tapering into the open black gown. Redraw the head with a curved chin and VERY SHORT BROAD transition at the actual shoulder/gown opening. Seat the original three pearl strands naturally on the broad upper chest directly under that short transition, retaining their count and original gown/hair/pose and photograph/note arrangement. Adapt collar and shoulder fit to the mascot rather than preserving a narrow human neck column. No cream bib, new undershirt, lost strand or floating pearls. Do not alter the actual opaque photograph interior. Preserve unrelated original-visible appearance and full raw resolution. No programmatic art patch.
